answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 45548 Country: India Title: Halal and Haram Question: Is it halal to eat bakery food like that of Britannia? What are the companies which make bakery food that are not halal to eat? Please give the name of company and their product. Answer ID: 45548 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 862/B-186/TB=1434) The bakery which prepares its products with halal, lawful and pure ingredients and its products do not contain haram and impure items, so it will be lawful to use and eat such products. We have not performed research on the products of all the companies nor have we done its survey. Hence we cannot write any Shariah ruling regarding their particular products. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
